Method of Attack: Scans the Internet for vulnerable IoT devices and uses exploit code to gain foothold, then rewrites device's flash storage with random data to brick devices
Impacted Systems: Various devices across Africa, Asia, and South America
Washington DC police surveillance camera storage devices (DVRs)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of exposed equipment via exploit code
Compromised ISP routers for lateral movement
Indicators of Compromise: Manifesto published on compromised devices containing BrickerBot source code
Official DHS alert following BrickerBot disclosure
